query: SELECT id, (extract($2 FROM created_at) * $3)::bigint AS sort_key FROM travel_plans ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT $1
SELECT p.*, COUNT(l.id)::integer AS location_count FROM travel_plans p LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.travel_plan_id = p.id WHERE p.id = ANY($1::uuid[]) GROUP BY p.id
SELECT * FROM locations WHERE travel_plan_id = $1 ORDER BY visit_order
SELECT id FROM travel_plans WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM locations WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT travel_plan_id FROM locations WHERE id = $1
UPDATE locations SET notes = $1, version = version + $4 WHERE id = $2 AND version = $3 RETURNING *
UPDATE travel_plans SET budget = $1, version = version + $4 WHERE id = $2 AND version = $3 RETURNING *
INSERT INTO locations (id, name, travel_plan_id, visit_order) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) RETURNING *
INSERT INTO travel_plans (id, title) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING *
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(visit_order), $2) + $3 AS next FROM locations WHERE travel_plan_id = $1
